review_kind: static incremental source review; zero native model calls
checks: checked_input_index reads bytes, enforces a hard-coded independently frozen index SHA before parsing, and enforces the exact schema and seed set.
Both main plan and main load_plan invoke the gate. load_plan separately requires sealed input_index_sha256 to equal both the hard constant and actual bytes.
input_payloads rereads all five role files with byte count and SHA checks, additionally retaining hard-coded original parent and raw-task input pins.

verify_case_inputs reconstructs profiles, raw inputs, exact fixed accuracy/radius request, per-role source references, expected mechanism and seed from the fixed index. The full sealed case must match those reconstructed values.
The working source path remains required to equal its owned expected workspace location and its bytes must hash to the exact original seed checkpoint.
Changed-executable control imports the reviewed main SHA, invokes the same hard index gate at plan and run, and revalidates the complete seed137 case before any native launch.
Incremental changes do not add model calls, candidates, optimization, retries, servers or recovery operations. Existing protocol and lifecycle limits remain unchanged.
V2 protocol files preserve superseded unexecuted V1 records and explicitly retain the recovered-workspace history.
limits: This is source review, not a new execution result. Both exact-head and prospective-merge CI jobs and the exact qualified package gates remain prerequisites.
Inputs are historical observed engineering batches; this does not create an independent scientific holdout.
Original pre-amendment reviews are retained; this amendment closes their missing hard-coded index admission condition.

Main protocol remains at most29 complete or partial forward source bound; separate changed-executable protocol remains at most5. Actual interrupted work must not be described as an exact observed call count.
